layout: Row 0 columns 0..3 retain standing, sitting, walk-a, walk-b. Columns 4..5 hold exercise and exercise-b for the 19 v2 entries shared with the exercise-enabled v3 set, downscaled 144x192 to 48x64 with Lanczos3 and premultiplied alpha. Other cells remain transparent reserved capacity. This is the front-only pose subset, not a completed four-direction animation set.
shadow: Generated translucent floor shadow included per frame. Do not double-render; future split shadow pass requires mask/extraction work.
pivotMeaning: Bottom center of included floor shadow; chair/desk masking must be validated by runtime owner.
